## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] For UI or browser-integration changes: `pnpm build` and
      [the manual Chrome checklist](../docs/manual-test.md)
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior or constraints changed

Include screenshots for visual changes and list any checks still pending.
